purpose: Two additional projects, three disclosed security-fix controls (one semantically disclosed but engine eligible), one comment-only exploratory negative; no silent-fix labels.

labels.label: security_fix
labels.original_subject: socks: return error if hostname too long for remote resolve
labels.original_body_summary: Explains an unsafe state-machine fallback and links the project's CVE advisory in the commit body.
labels.correction_summary: Reject overlong remotely resolved SOCKS5 hostnames instead of falling back to local resolution; add a regression case.

timeline.limitation: Git author/committer times do not prove when a commit first became public. The original full message declares its security context.

labels.label: security_fix
labels.original_subject: lib: Add missing validation of encoding (CVE-2022-25235)
labels.correction_summary: Reject invalid multi-byte characters in tokenizer paths before passing malformed text to downstream XML handlers.

timeline.limitation: The earlier author date is not evidence of a silent public period. Original subject explicitly identifies the CVE; public visibility and initial report time were not established.

labels.label: non_security
labels.review_basis: Read complete first-parent diff: four typo corrections in C/CMake comments across three files; no executable expression, declaration, literal or build command changed.
labels.selection: First five default predictions reviewed after scanning; exploratory label, not a predeclared held-out evaluation sample.

labels.label: security_fix
labels.original_subject: lib: Protect against billion laughs attacks (approach 3.0.21)
labels.original_body_summary: No body; original message consists of the subject alone.
labels.review_basis: Official public PR 466 explicitly identifies CVE-2013-0340/CWE-776 and lists this exact fix commit; official 2.4.0 release changelog identifies PR 466 under security fixes for entity amplification attacks.
labels.correction_summary: Add input-amplification accounting, bounded amplification defaults and an abort error for excessive entity expansion.
labels.selection: Exploratory additional candidate selected after inspecting scan output; not held out.
labels.engine_eligibility_warning: Existing message-keyword filter admits this subject despite its explicit attack-defense meaning. Engine eligible recall for this label is not silent-fix recall.

timeline.limitation: Current PR history gives dated public-security context; no exact initial publication timestamp is claimed. Original subject explicitly describes protection against an attack.
